output.reason: The release note [ev-cb880878ba69] says only that the `istio.io/gateway-name` label was removed and that `gateway.networking.k8s.io/gateway-name` should be used instead. It does not say which resources carry or select on the label, such as Gateway objects, generated gateway Deployments, Services or Pods, or policy selectors. Nothing in the evidence supports limiting exposure to Gateway resources that set the label. The proposed condition also uses the group "networking.k8s.io", which does not match the `gateway.networking.k8s.io` namespace shown in the note. To build an exact exposure condition, we need evidence of where Istio set or read this label: the PR or upgrade notes for 52049, or a rendered or code diff.
